action_requested.text_hi: ₹5,000 "tax" bhejo tabhi apna profit nikal paoge.
action_requested.text_en: Pay ₹5,000 "tax" before you can withdraw your profit.

items.label: CONTRADICTED
items.title_hi: Paisa nikalne ke liye naya deposit/fee
items.title_en: New deposit or fee to withdraw
items.why_hi: Asli platform apna paisa nikalne ke liye naya paisa nahi maangte. Yeh "withdrawal blocked" charan se match karta hai.
items.why_en: Genuine platforms do not need new money to release yours. This matches the withdrawal-blocked stage.
items.settle_hi: Platform ko SEBI ki authorised-app list mein dhundhein.
items.settle_en: Look for the platform in SEBI's authorised-app list.

items.label: COULDNT_VERIFY
items.title_hi: App store se nahi, .apk link se aaya
items.title_en: App came from an .apk link, not a store
items.why_hi: Store listing ke bina app ka link bharosa nahi dilata.
items.why_en: An app link without a store listing is not reassuring.
items.settle_hi: Sirf official store ya SEBI list wala app hi use karein.
items.settle_en: Use only apps from an official store or SEBI's list.

items.label: COULDNT_VERIFY
items.title_hi: App mein ₹1.75L profit dikh raha hai
items.why_hi: App ya chat ki screen asli munafe ka saboot nahi hoti.
items.why_en: Screens inside a chat or unknown app are not evidence of real returns.
items.settle_hi: Apne bank mein asli paisa aaya ya nahi dekhein.
items.settle_en: Check whether real money arrived in your bank.

stage.name: WITHDRAWAL_BLOCKED
stage.because_hi: Kyunki paisa nikalne ke liye aur paise maange ja rahe hain.
stage.because_en: Because more money is requested to withdraw.
